comment: SimProc's pins, as a Pmod for it must connect them. Read by labs/common/check_pmod.py. Sources: uoftasic/simproc at 1d97772 (info.yaml; src/tt_um_ieeeuoftasic_simproc.sv: uio_oe = 8'b0000_0000, clk_per_bit = {uio_in[7:0], 2'b00}; docs/info.md: 'Send commands using the UART RX pin (using a USB to UART conveter)', 'Set UIO7-UIO0 to set the BAUD rate'). Pmod pin numbers follow the demo board's sockets J14, J15 and J16 (TinyTapeout/tt-demo-pcb bbf3dd1): bits 0-3 on pins 1-4, bits 4-7 on pins 7-10, GND on 5 and 11, +3V3 on 6 and 12.
